## `set_project_meta_data`

*Available in [R](#set_project_meta_data-r)*
=== "R"
    <h4>Description</h4>

    Allows you to set misc project data parameters
    for Project Name, Analyst, or PI recommend you use specific function

    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```R

    set_project_meta_data(parameter, value)

    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `parameter` - Project Parameter to be set
    - `value` - Value to set to project parameter
